overview: The plan combines an internet-facing administrative port, an unconstrained IAM policy, and weakened S3 safeguards. The deterministic findings should be resolved before merge.

findings.title: Public SSH and wildcard IAM compound compromise impact
findings.evidence: SSH is open to 0.0.0.0/0 while the application policy allows every action on every resource.
findings.impact: A compromised workload or credential could gain broad account access.
findings.recommendation: Restrict SSH to an approved network or Session Manager and grant only required S3 actions on the application bucket.

findings.title: Bucket recovery and exposure controls are missing
findings.evidence: The scanner reports no versioning and no Public Access Block for the bucket.
findings.impact: Objects are easier to expose or lose through accidental overwrite and deletion.
findings.recommendation: Enable versioning and restore all four S3 Public Access Block settings.

questions: What approved operator network requires direct SSH access?
Which exact S3 API operations does the application need?
